historical_root_cause_wording_audit.description: The historical script run_smoke_local.py was never committed to git. The fault injection test uses a synthetic faulty selector that deliberately combines: development_train with lc_n50=true AND all inner_validation rows. This produces 141 source_ids, 282 samples (buggy) vs 91 source_ids, 182 samples (correct).
historical_root_cause_wording_audit.note: This is a synthetic symptom reproduction, NOT proof of the exact historical code path. The historical script run_smoke_local.py does not exist in git. The documented buggy expression 'if row[partition] == partition and (partition != inner_validation or row[lc_n50] == True)' when partition=inner_validation evaluates to True for inner_validation rows (since partition == inner_validation is True and partition != inner_validation is False, but lc_n50 == True for all inner_validation rows). When partition=development_train, the condition partition != inner_validation is True making the OR True. The documented buggy filter is equivalent to: (partition == development_train and lc_n50 == True) OR (partition == inner_validation).
historical_root_cause_wording_audit.fault_injection_method: Synthetic union of development_train (lc_n50=true) and all inner_validation rows
removed_claims: The buggy filter automatically selects development rows when partition == inner_validation
